QUOTE: `scripts/generate_errors.pl` scans every `include/mbedtls/*.h` for `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<X> -0x....` lines... and it emits `library/error.c` from `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`. `library/error.c` is therefore generated.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl using error.fmt as the template.
